items.title: Fix eval_task_tier1 to honor the NEVER RAISES promise
items.why_now: Confirmed: unguarded task['repo'] and task['target'] can raise KeyError, contradicting the docstring. This can crash the evaluation tier and break the vertical slice.

steps.do: Change the unguarded subscript accesses to use .get with a default or raise a documented exception type, and update the docstring accordingly.
steps.verified_by: A unit test passes a task dict missing 'repo' or 'target' and asserts no KeyError is raised.

items.title: Fix unparsable-half counting to match documented behavior
items.why_now: Confirmed: row['n'] is incremented for unparsable halves, contradicting the comment that they are not counted. This skews detection rates and can invalidate evaluation results.

steps.do: Adjust the counting logic so unparsable halves are not included in the denominator (or update the comment if the behavior is intentional).
steps.verified_by: A test with an unparsable half asserts the denominator excludes it.

items.title: Fix deleted-file-anchor contradiction in slice fallback
items.why_now: Confirmed: fallback to per_file includes deleted files, contradicting the docstring claim. This can make a deleted file the anchor, leading to incorrect slices.

steps.do: Modify the fallback to exclude deleted files, or update the docstring to reflect the actual behavior.
steps.verified_by: A test with a diff where existing is empty and deleted files are present asserts the anchor is not a deleted file.

items.title: Fix lifecycle-events misrepresented as agent messages
items.why_now: Confirmed: unknown events are returned as AgentMessage with role='system', contradicting the comment. This can pollute conversation history with non-model text.

steps.do: Change the fallback to return a different type or raise an error for unknown events, and ensure lifecycle events do not hit it.
steps.verified_by: A test feeds a lifecycle event and asserts it is not returned as an AgentMessage.

items.title: Fix fail-closed-guard-role-comparison case sensitivity
items.why_now: Confirmed: role check is case-sensitive, contradicting the docstring. This can allow unauthorized roles to pass the guard.

steps.do: Change the comparison to be case-insensitive (e.g., role.lower() == 'focus').
steps.verified_by: A test with role='Focus' passes the guard.

items.title: Fix independence-classification ambiguity
items.why_now: Confirmed: independence is defined inconsistently (agreement rate vs. model family vs. weights). This can lead to misclassification of vendor independence.

steps.do: Unify the definition of independence into a single function and update all references to use it.
steps.verified_by: A test asserts that all usages of 'independence' refer to the same definition.

items.title: Fix duplicate constants to prevent drift
items.why_now: Confirmed: VENDOR_KEYS, DEFAULT_GATE_TIMEOUT_S, RUNTIME_PROFILES are defined independently without a shared source. Drift can cause inconsistent behavior.

steps.do: Move these constants to a central module and import them everywhere, or add a test that asserts equality across modules.
steps.verified_by: A test compares the constants across modules and fails if they differ.
